SELECT d.fiscal_year,
  COUNT(*) n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) n_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) n_rl,
  MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) l0, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) l1, MIN(f.sale_date) d0, MAX(f.sale_date) d1,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1

WITH n AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1,2,3),
r AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) nb
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT COALESCE(n.fiscal_year,r.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(n.store_id,r.store_id) st, SUM(n.net) fact, SUM(r.nb) rpt, SUM(n.net)-SUM(r.nb) diff
FROM n FULL JOIN r ON n.fiscal_year=r.fiscal_year AND n.fiscal_week=r.fiscal_week AND n.store_id=r.store_id
GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING ABS(COALESCE(SUM(n.net),0)-COALESCE(SUM(r.nb),0))>0.5 OR SUM(n.net) IS NULL OR SUM(r.nb) IS NULL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
sw AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) net
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT store_id, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net END) ty, SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net END) ly,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN 1 END) wk_ty, COUNT(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN 1 END) wk_ly,
  MIN(net) min_wk
FROM sw GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900 AND st.store_id <> 999
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-08-03' - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year, ty.stores sty, ly.stores sly,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty, lfl_sales ly
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
